recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes ValueSet.identifier back to a URI-valued element or otherwise changes its search semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-5578 asked to change the ValueSet identifier search parameter to type uri because the DSTU1 ValueSet.identifier element was URI-valued; the final Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution said to use URI search type for all URI-valued elements.
initial_application: Jira records the original application as SVN revision 4492. The current Git history for the relevant ValueSet source files has no direct FHIR-5578/5578 commit, and the current XML source was reintroduced in the 2021 build/source refactor with ValueSet.identifier already represented as Identifier with a token search parameter.
additional_context: Later published decisions distinguish canonical URI identification from business identifiers: FHIR-8492 points value-set URI references to ValueSet.url, FHIR-9391 makes ValueSet.identifier repeatable, and FHIR-26549 describes ValueSet.identifier as an Identifier business identifier. ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current source gives URI search type to ValueSet.url, ValueSet.expansion.identifier, and ValueSet.compose.include.system.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is appropriate because changing ValueSet-identifier to uri would contradict the current ValueSet.identifier datatype and current search semantics.
